coming_up_next.summary: Granting the Google Calendar permission will switch on adding rehearsals to your calendar, and the app will say so before and after.
coming_up_next.title: Google Calendar permission means your calendar

recommended_steps.detail: With a real Google Calendar that has something during the request's time of day.
recommended_steps.title: Walk the User Demo

recommended_steps.detail: Pressing Enter in the preferred-number box sends a first answer; keep it or change it.
recommended_steps.title: Decide on the Enter key

recommended_steps.detail: Run kickoff when ready; it will ask which groups switch on and what happens to members who left syncing off.
recommended_steps.title: Start Phase 32

see_for_yourself.expected: Every free date starts ticked; the organizer sees nothing until you send, then exactly what you sent.
steps: As a member, open an availability request you haven't answered.
Untick a date, press Clear all then Select all, and send.
see_for_yourself.title: Answer a new request

what_just_landed.detail: A member's first answer starts with every date ticked except those their Google Calendar shows them busy at the request's time; dates they already gave stay ticked.
what_just_landed.title: Every free date already ticked

what_just_landed.detail: Select all and Clear all with a count, and one Send for the dates and the preferred number; nothing is saved before it.
what_just_landed.title: Select all, Clear all, one Send

what_just_landed.detail: Once answered, Select all saves every date at once and Clear all clears them after asking.
what_just_landed.title: Faster changes after answering
